## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] I reviewed the diff for accidental or unrelated changes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks and recorded the result.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, private credentials, recovery codes, or authentication material.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior, setup, or usage changed.

## Review notes

Call out risks, screenshots, follow-up work, compatibility concerns, or anything else that helps reviewers evaluate this change.
